anne_custsuccess: Quick micro-sprint to lock the Q2 readout deck + exec asks. Can we triage slide owners, 3 must-have metrics, renewal-risk flags, and demo fallback before EOD?

maria_onboarding: I can own onboarding status slide. Top two accounts with gaps: NeoBank (API key exchange stuck), Harborline (private deploy onboarding delayed). Will add short remediation bullets.

sam_platform: Heads-up: remove perf waterfall from main deck, move to appendix. It's noisy and will derail exec time. I'll swap in 2 simple latency + cost numbers.
dave_account_exec: +1 on trimming. Execs want revenue impact and renewal signal up top. For NeoBank — flag as "at-risk" unless API key by Wed.
linda_enablement: Demo owners: I can run the live fallback demo if the main demo hits infra. Backup: recorded video + script. Can we get a dry run Thurs 3pm?

anne_custsuccess: Dry run Thurs 3pm works. Maria — can you add remediation ETA for NeoBank and Harborline by tomorrow noon? Sam — update slides by tomorrow 5pm. Linda — upload demo script by Wed EOD.

maria_onboarding: Yep — will add ETA + owner initials. Also adding a 1-line ask for sales to confirm renewal cadence with Harborline.
sam_platform: I'll replace waterfall with:
```
Slide X: latency median 95ms / cost $0.002/token (hosted avg)
Slide X+1: perf appendix link -> /runtimes/perf-q2
```

linda_enablement: Demo script uploaded to the runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/q2-readout-demo. Will do a 30-min dry run with Anne before Thurs.
dave_account_exec: For exec ask list, prioritize: 1) Renewal signal + recommended outreach (owner: Dave) 2) Dedicated capacity ask for Harborline (owner: Anne) 3) Risk mitigation play for NeoBank (owner: Maria).

anne_custsuccess: I'll consolidate into an action list. Quick status check in an hour? Ping here when your item is done.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent for Dry Run — Thu 15:00-15:45 (organizer: anne_custsuccess).

maria_onboarding: ETA notes added. NeoBank: awaiting security sign-off (rm: 48h). Harborline: infra provision scheduled Mon.
sam_platform: Slides updated and uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/q2-readout/v3 (changed perf to appendix).
linda_enablement: Demo script v2 uploaded, recorded fallback ready. 30-min pre-dry-run with Anne scheduled Wed 16:00.
dave_account_exec: Drafted exec ask bullets in the deck. Marking NeoBank as at-risk -> renewal playbook assigned.

anne_custsuccess: Awesome — closing loop. Final checklist for EOD: slide owners ✅, demo fallback ✅, renewal flags ✅. I'll do a last pass tomorrow morning and send exec pre-read. :thumbsup:

maria_onboarding: Thanks — will follow up with NeoBank security lead.

sam_platform: Good to go from my side.

linda_enablement: Ready for dry run.

dave_account_exec: Thanks team.

anne_custsuccess: Filing action items below for visibility:
• Maria — NeoBank remediation ETA + security contact (due: tomorrow 12:00)
• Maria — Harborline provision status + sales handshake (due: tomorrow 12:00)
• Sam — Slide updates (due: tomorrow 17:00)
• Linda — Demo script + pre-dry-run (due: Wed 16:00)
• Dave — Exec ask bullets finalized (due: tomorrow EOD)

anne_custsuccess: If anyone sees anything missing call it out here. Otherwise I'll convert to a small task board and ping owners.

maria_onboarding: All good from me.

sam_platform: All set.

linda_enablement: 👍

dave_account_exec: 👍
